50 | Mass Vision | 1 tgt/lvl | 10 min/lvl | 10' | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster can tell the exact dimensions, mass, and/or weight of one object.
@@ 2
Target gains double normal hearing. This results in a special bonus of +50 to
Awareness-Searching and Awareness-Senses skills involving only hearing (or +5
for Alertness skill). This bonus is +25 to such skills involving hearing and
other senses (or +3 for Alertness skill).
@@ 3
Target gets a special bonus of +50 for maneuver rolls for a slow maneuver
requiring balance (e.g., walking a 3'' beam).
@@ 4
Target can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See Section
15.12 (p. 98).
@@ 5
Target has a 300º field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against the
target is lowered to +5 and the rear bonus is lowered to +15.
@@ 6
Target's voice has its loudness tripled. This has no effect on spell casting
capabilities (it simply allows the caster to make himself heard without
difficulty over long distances).
@@ 7
As Nightvision, except target can see 100' in any water; even muddy, murky
water.
@@ 8
Target can breathe water but not air.
@@ 9
As Nightvision, except target can see varying degrees of heat on the surfaces
of objects. This spell does not allow the caster to see “through” things. This
vision is not sufficient for detailed actions like reading or mapping.
@@ 10
As Waterlungs, except target can breathe any gas as normal air.
@@ 11
Delays the effect of a poison on a target. If poison is not eliminated before
the spell expires, the target will be affected by the poison at that time.
@@ 12
As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is
needed at all for this spell to work.
@@ 15
As Waterlungs, except target can breathe water, air, and/or any gas at will.
@@ 16
As Balance, except can affect one target per level of caster.
@@ 18
As Nightvision, except can affect one target per level of caster.
@@ 19
As Watervision, except can affect one target/level of caster.
@@ 20
As all “vision” spells below 15th level functioning at the same time.
@@ 25
As Waterlungs, except can affect 1 target per level of caster.
@@ 30
As Gaslungs, except can affect 1 target per level of caster.
@@ 50
As Vision, except can affect 1 target per level of caster.
